name: The Impostor Question
shortDescription: A host-led Zoom icebreaker where everyone answers a vague question, one hidden impostor bluffs without knowing the shared topic, and the group votes before a final topic-guess twist.

generation.notes: Built from approved issue #407. Duplication risk was high for Icebreakers, so the implementation emphasizes a distinct hidden-role topic-deduction loop rather than anonymous answer guessing or word-clue team play. Uses the shared multiplayer session API, /join/{code} entry, moderator-authored state transitions, and player answer/vote submissions through the shared answers endpoint. Token counts are estimated.

suggestion.prompt: Build app called The Impostor Question for Zoom-style icebreaker game. Moderator shares a join link, chooses rounds, and sees player grid, status, and score. Players join, enter their name, and wait for start. One random impostor is assigned while others get a shared topic. A vague question is shown, players take turns answering, then vote who the impostor is with no self-vote. Reveal impostor and votes; if not caught, impostor guesses the topic. Maintain room state for players, roles, topic, responses, votes, and gameState with large, clean, Zoom-friendly UI.

improvements.description: Fixed the player join flow by storing the canonical app path used by the shared /join redirect.

Fixed voting race condition: concurrent vote submissions caused last-writer-wins data loss. Added record_session_vote SQL RPC with SELECT FOR UPDATE row locking and JSONB || merge so all votes are recorded atomically.

Fixed regression from #411: answers endpoint called record_session_vote RPC for all quiz-vote submissions but the SQL migration was not yet deployed, breaking Submit Answer. Gated the RPC on game.stage==='vote'; answer and topic-guess stages use the original non-atomic path (safe since they are turn-based).

Added private topic popup for moderators: main screen now shows 'Topic hidden' so Zoom screen-share is safe; a 'View topic in private window' button opens a popup with the topic and impostor name that the moderator can drag to their non-shared monitor; popup auto-updates via postMessage when a new round starts.

Added a Help modal accessible from all screens via a Help button in the hero. The modal covers gameplay basics, step-by-step moderator instructions, player instructions, and a scoring reference table.
